description.value: Our Root Cellar is the fresh produce department of The Old Country Market, a Coombs landmark that began as a roadside stand over 50 years ago and is now famous for its rooftop goats. It stocks fresh produce sourced from Vancouver Island and beyond, and sits within a sprawling complex that also includes a deli, bakery, multiple restaurants, a gift shop, and an ice cream stand. A large shaded forested parking lot at the rear of the property accommodates RVs and makes the whole complex a natural rest stop for cyclists on the route toward the west coast of Vancouver Island.
